sections.title: Complete Layer 11 Summary
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              LAYER 11: SAFETY & ALIGNMENT SUMMARY                │
├──────────────────────┬────────────────────────┬──────────────────┤
│  Protection Layer    │  Threat Neutralized    │  When It Fires   │
├──────────────────────┼────────────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│  Input Guard         │  Prompt injection      │  Every request   │
│  (Layer 1)           │  Jailbreak attempts    │  Before LLM      │
│                      │  Malicious patterns    │                  │
├──────────────────────┼────────────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│  PII Detection       │  Privacy data leaks    │  Input & output  │
│  (Layer 2 & 5)       │  GDPR violations       │  Both directions │
│                      │  Identity exposure     │                  │
├──────────────────────┼────────────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│  Tool Safety         │  Dangerous tool use    │  Before tool     │
│  (Layer 3)           │  Data destruction      │  execution       │
│                      │  Unauthorized access   │                  │
├──────────────────────┼────────────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│  Human-in-the-Loop   │  Irreversible actions  │  High-risk ops   │
│  (Layer 3)           │  Financial risk        │  Auto by risk    │
│                      │  Bulk operations       │  level           │
├──────────────────────┼────────────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│  Output Guard        │  Harmful content       │  After LLM       │
│  (Layer 4)           │  Hallucinations        │  Before user     │
│                      │  Brand violations      │                  │
├──────────────────────┼────────────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│  Audit Logging       │  Compliance failures   │  Every event     │
│  (Layer 6)           │  Forensic blind spots  │  Always active   │
│                      │  Undetected attacks    │                  │
└──────────────────────┴────────────────────────┴──────────────────┘

  SAFETY DEPLOYMENT CHECKLIST:
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ✅ Input Guard blocks injection & jailbreak on every request
  ✅ PII is masked in both input AND output
  ✅ All LLM outputs pass through moderation API
  ✅ Destructive/financial actions require human approval
  ✅ Tool execution has parameter validation
  ✅ Every security event is audit-logged with timestamp
  ✅ Hallucination risk triggers user-facing disclaimers
  ✅ Rate limiting prevents abuse (covered in Layer 10)
  ✅ System prompt is in system role (never user role)
  ✅ External content is sandboxed before LLM processing

  THE SAFETY MINDSET:
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ❌ "Our users are trustworthy, we don't need safety"
  ✅ "Any input can be malicious — trust nothing, verify everything"

  ❌ "Safety slows us down"
  ✅ "Safety patterns add <50ms — a data breach costs $4.88M"

  ❌ "We'll add safety later"
  ✅ "Safety is foundational — retrofit is 10x harder than build-in"
```
